summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a Pilot Cooperation Agreement with RBtec to integrate its RF sensing technology into RBtec's perimeter intrusion detection system for a security-sector end-customer. The pilot is expected to run six months; terms of a potential commercial agreement will be discussed afterward. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed. This is a routine commercial pilot agreement, not a special situation. It reflects a strategic expansion but does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, or other event-driven category.
